page_title: CAG 0-2 BOL | Cagliari v Bologna 19/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' Close! Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post.
90+3' Rough tackle by Jens Odgaard (Bologna). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Cagliari.
90+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) was quite harsh and Matteo Marchetti didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+1' The resulting free kick from Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) will replace Emil Holm.
87' The Bologna players are stunned as the referee changes his mind following the VAR review. NO PENALTY.
86' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Bologna as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
85' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul. It's a penalty for Bologna!
84' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Elia Caprile pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
80' 0 - 2 Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) blasts the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it flies straight into the top right corner of the net!
80' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.
79' A long ball forward to Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) is intercepted. Good work from Bologna as they win a corner.
79' Substitution. Sebastiano Esposito did his best and is replaced by Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari).

78' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Federico Ravaglia pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
77' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Nicolo Cambiaghi and he is replaced by Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna).
77' Substitution. Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) replaces Remo Freuler.
76' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
73' Good movement by Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
70' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 41:59.
68' Fabio Pisacane prepares a substitution. Matteo Prati is replaced by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari).
68' The referee signals a substitution. Jose Pedro (Cagliari) is brought on as a substitute for Yerry Mina.
64' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) heads on.
63' A free kick has been awarded to Cagliari.
62' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
59' The manager makes a subsitution with Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) coming on for Juan Miranda.
59' That's the end of the game for Federico Bernardeschi, who is replaced by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna).
55' It's time for a substitution. Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) comes on in place of Mattia Felici.
54' Fabio Pisacane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) replacing Gabriele Zappa.
54' Bologna take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.

53' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle after Matteo Prati (Cagliari) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Bologna win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
50' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
50' Bologna take a short corner kick.
50' Juan Miranda (Bologna) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play. Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) hits a piledriver from the edge of the box, but Elia Caprile acrobatically dives to stop the effort. Superb save!
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' Cagliari fail to score from a corner as Federico Ravaglia (Bologna) leaps to collect the ball.
43' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score. The ball is out of play and Cagliari manage to earn a corner.
42' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle as Emil Holm (Bologna) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
39' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.

39' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Bologna have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
38' Bologna will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
38' The ball is cleared after Santiago Castro (Bologna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Bologna get a corner.
31' 0 - 1 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Emil Holm (Bologna) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Jens Odgaard knock down. 0:1.
30' There's an opportunity for Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

30' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Elia Caprile easily deals with the threat. The referee points to the corner flag and Bologna will take a corner.

30' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
29' Great touch by Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
27' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) has a goal ruled out for offside!
22' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
22' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari). The ball goes behind for a corner. Cagliari will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
21' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
16' Juan Miranda (Bologna) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
15' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
13' Juan Miranda (Bologna) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
10' Bologna keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
2' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) swings in a cross from the corner, but Elia Caprile reads it well and gathers the ball.
2' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Bologna force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
